versions.detection:
selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\crushftp.exe'
selection_child_powershell:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\powershell.exe'
        - '\powershell_ise.exe'
        - '\pwsh.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'IEX'
        - 'enc'
        - 'Hidden'
        - 'bypass'
selection_child_cmd:
    Image|endswith: '\cmd.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '/c powershell'
        - 'whoami'
        - 'net.exe'
        - 'net1.exe'
selection_child_others:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\bitsadmin.exe'
        - '\certutil.exe'
        - '\mshta.exe'
        - '\cscript.exe'
        - '\wscript.exe'
condition: selection_parent and 1 of selection_child_*
